notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi friends,


It's time for an Update #2 of the game!

- New location “Miami Beach” with a motorcycle and new tasks

- New location “Night Club”, which can be accessed after completing all levels

- Added a couple of new characters in the locations

- Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi friends,


It's time for an update of the game!

- New mechanics of riding a motorcycle in the forest location

- Some objects were changed on the game locations to fit in more with the atmosphere of the game

- Fixed minor bugs

- Minor changes to some aspects of the game

notes.title: Release of TRADING CARDS and BIG SALE!
notes.content:
Friends!

Finally Steam approved our trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges!

In total, 5 badges (+1 metal), 12 cards, 5 emoticons and 9 backgrounds were added.

CHECK IT OUT IN POINT SHOP 🐺

More information on trading cards, backgrounds and emoticons - Here 🦊


To get one trading card, you need to spend 5 minutes in the game


We look forward to your feedback in the comments and discussions!

Thank you for your help and support on the way to obtaining these trading cards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895667/0999d412c169cb97852903df75fdb12cb89733ee.png

notes.title: THE GAME WAS RELEASED!!!
notes.content:
Friends, the game was released!

We invite you to play this unique masterpiece of the gaming industry!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895667/0999d412c169cb97852903df75fdb12cb89733ee.png

Call all your acquaintances, friends, relatives to play Mister Furry: Hot Muscles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578220/Mister_Furry_Hot_Muscles/

We will be very happy if you tell us your opinion about the game in the form of a review and give us feedback in the comments and discussions.

Thank you!



Dungeon Master

notes.title: Trading Cards & Emoticons & Badges & BGs
notes.content:
Hey guys!

This is a demo of Trading Cards, Emoticons (also there will be BGs and Badges) that we will see with you on Steam, if we overcome the necessary barrier, it's about the Number of Additions to the Steam Wishlist, Purchases and the Number of Game Launches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895667/f92c86f92fc003e834cec156be62dfa8d8fa8e07.png

Not all of the items that will be added are shown here, this is just a demonstration of a small part :)

What do you think about it? We will be glad to hear your opinion in the comments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895667/0999d412c169cb97852903df75fdb12cb89733ee.png

Also write your ideas about cards in a special topic in the discussions of the game.

We really appreciate this, as well as your help in obtaining these trading cards! :)
